records.name: Credit Reader

mechanics.detect: Determine if a target's credits are real or credit line exists

findings.detail: SGD p61 describes a portable backpack transmitter and handheld computer controller. Raw registry category offensive risks classifying it as a droid-installed part.
Standard action every activator turn, compare that check at beginning of each eligible target turn; no actions/flat-footed only if >= Will; backup processors immune.
Published recovery roll d20+max(10, current Use Computer modifier) vs DC20 with retry each 1d6 days; raw description only notes DC20.
Main processor concealment has unlisted weight, external store weighs 1kg; 400 credit enhanced detection Will 30 variant must not be flattened into same 1kg SKU.
Table price 50 credits/1kg Licensed; overlay-only cost and weight absent; default helper can return zero.
Custom build 5,000+ credits, weight 2kg+, Illegal; raw fixed values only minima, not exact published sale price; connected tool, not body upgrade.
Printed +50% base, DC30 additional up to 100% for one hour; exact additive vs replacement multiplier not stated explicitly; do not assume +150%.
+5 equipment applies to facility communication computer intrusion to shut down or maintain jamming, not all Use Computer including local DC25.
Raw data states unavailable/typically unavailable at chargen; inspected printed entries provide Military/Licensed but not universal chargen prohibitions.
Droid caller permits owner-directed half-speed locomotion only; not attacks, possessions or processor transfer.
Remote starter allows preflight signaling and diagnostics, not ship piloting or arbitrary vehicle system execution.
